POKIT 앱 소개, 화면 안내, 자주 묻는 질문과 문의 창구입니다. 계: About POKIT, screen guide, FAQ, and contact. An iOS routine app you can use without an account.
POKIT은 하루의 루틴을 가볍게 담고, 집중할 시간을 스스로 정해 가는: POKIT is an iOS app for keeping today's routines light and setting your own focus window.
시간표를 촘촘히 채우지 않아도 됩니다. 오늘 하고 싶은 루틴만 골라 담고: You do not need to fill a tight timetable. Pick only the routines you want today, then follow them in order. Thoughts go into notes and to-dos, books you want to read go into the bookshop, and when the day ends they stay as a small mark in History.
계정 가입 없이 바로 사용할 수 있습니다. 앱 이름 POKIT을 제외한: You can start without signing up. Except for the app name POKIT, on-screen copy supports Korean, English, and Japanese, and follows the device language.
POKIT은 할 일을 달력에 욱여넣거나, 분 단위 스케줄에 맞추느라 지치: POKIT is built so you do not have to cram tasks onto a calendar or burn out matching a minute-by-minute schedule.
오늘 무엇을, 어떤 순서로 할지 정하면 됩니다. 집중할 구간은 내가 정한: Decide what to do today, and in what order. Focus runs inside the start and wrap-up times you set. Mark what matters with a highlighter underline, and close what is done. Empty time is not a failure.
처음 앱을 켜면 하루의 시작·마무리 시각을 정합니다. 이후에는 설정 →: The first time you open the app, you set when your day starts and ends. After that, you can change it anytime in Settings → Start & wrap-up.
더 자세한 화면 안내는 앱 안 설정 → 사용 설명서, 또는 오늘 담기의: For a closer look at each screen, open Settings → User guide, or Quick look at POKIT in Today's tray.
Today: keep the routines you will focus on, and see them as a list inside start~wrap-up. A one-line note of encouragement sits next to the date and changes each day.
루틴: 건강·생산성·일상 루틴을 둘러보고, 검색하고, 포스트잇처럼 묶어: Routines: browse health, productivity, and everyday routines, search them, and group them like sticky notes.
나만의 루틴: 데일리·주말·내 그룹을 만들고, 요일을 고른 뒤 「적용하기: My routines: make Daily, Weekend, and your own groups, pick weekdays, then use Apply to bring them into Today.
History: look back at completed routines and focus by week or month.
스토리: 글을 읽다가 마음에 남는 루틴이 있으면 그대로 저장해 내 하루에: Story: if a routine in an article stays with you, save it and add it to your day.
오늘 탭 위쪽 모드: Modes at the top of Today
Separate from the bottom tabs, you can change modes at the top of the Today screen.
Daily: the default screen with Today's tray and the list.
Lock-screen memo: write a short memo for the lock screen.
노트: 하루 생각을 길게 남깁니다. 사진 첨부, 글머리/번호 목록, 공유: Note: write longer thoughts for the day. You can attach photos, use bullets or numbers, and share.
독서: 읽고 싶은 책을 담고 진행을 기록합니다. (책방): Reading: keep books you want to read and log progress. (Bookshop)
헤더의 투두 아이콘을 누르면 그날의 할 일 화면으로 바로 갈 수 있습니다: Tap the to-do icon in the header to jump to that day's tasks. It is a light place for the day's to-dos, apart from routines.
Add today's routines in order of what matters.
「루틴 추가」로 여러 개를 한 번에 고르거나, 「새로운 루틴 만들기」로: Use Add routines to pick several at once, or Create a new routine to make one.
Importance is a highlighter underline on the title in the color you pick.
A mint check in a black circle marks done. Tap again to undo.
행을 펼치면 요약·시간·템플릿(할 일·메모·값 기록 등)이 나옵니다. 슬: Expand a row to see the summary, time, and template (tasks, memo, value log, and more). The slider icon opens full details.
If the tray has two or more items, press and hold to reorder.
오늘 탭에는 따로 「시작하기」 버튼이 없습니다. 담기에 루틴이 생기면 집: Today has no separate Start button. Focus starts on its own when a routine is in the tray.
Tap the time in the header to set when the day starts and wraps up.
You can set midnight, AM/PM, or the next day.
마무리가 시작보다 이르면 다음날로 이어지는 하루로 이해합니다. (예: 밤: If wrap-up is earlier than start, the day continues into the next calendar day. (Example: start at 11 PM, wrap up at 2 AM the next day.)
집중 구간이 끝나면 담기와 집중 상태가 정리되고, 미완료 흐름이 마무리되: When the focus window ends, the tray and focus state are cleared, unfinished flow wraps up, and it can remain in History.
설정 → 시작·마무리에서 「하루가 지나면 담기 유지」를 켜면 담기를 더: In Settings → Start & wrap-up, turn on Keep the tray after the day ends to leave items in the tray longer.
Search the list in the Routines tab and sort it into sticky-note groups.
Use + to make a new routine or a new group.
항목을 펼치면 중요도(형광펜 밑줄)를 고르고, 상세 설정으로 갈 수 있습: Expand an item to pick importance (highlighter underline) and open details.
Last 30 days · N times is how often you added it to Today.
묶음은 이름·설명 편집·삭제가 가능하고, 항목은 옮기기·숨기기·삭제가 종: You can edit or delete a group's name and description. Moving, hiding, or deleting items depends on the type.
When you create a routine or expand a Today row, you can use these styles.
Task check: check tasks off one by one.
값 기록: 체중·수면 등 숫자를 입력하거나 ±로 조절하면 바로 저장됩니다: Value log: enter a number such as weight or sleep, or adjust it with ±, and it saves right away.
Fill a count: fill the target count with −/+.
Timed reminder: check done at the times you set.
건강 섭취, 수분, 체중조절, 독서, 노트, 회고처럼 목적에 맞는 루틴도: You can also use purpose-built routines such as health intake, water, weight, reading, notes, and reflection.
Daily fixed routines and Weekend fixed routines come built in.
직접 그룹을 만들고, 적용 요일(월~일)을 고른 뒤 「적용하기」를 켜면: Make your own group, pick the days (Mon~Sun), then turn on Apply to add them to Today's tray on those days.
When it is on, it shows Applying. Tap again to turn it off.
집중 구간이 끝나면 「적용하기」가 흐려집니다. 오늘 탭에서 집중 시간을: When the focus window ends, Apply fades. Change the focus time on Today, then apply again.
주말 고정 루틴은 적용을 켜 두면 선택한 요일(기본 토·일)에 오늘 탭에: If Weekend fixed routines stay applied, they land on Today automatically on the days you picked (Saturday and Sunday by default).
투두: 루틴과 별도로 그날의 할 일을 정리합니다. 중요도 밑줄, 세부 할: To-dos: organize that day's tasks apart from routines. Importance underline, subtasks, time, copy, and share are supported.
노트: 하루 기록을 길게 남깁니다. 제목 수정, 사진 첨부, 목록, 공유: Notes: keep a longer record of the day. You can edit the title, attach photos, use lists, and share.
Reading (Bookshop): keep books you want to read and log progress.
Lock-screen memo: write a short memo to see on the lock screen.
히스토리: 주간/월간 보기를 바꾸고, 이전·다음 기간으로 이동하며 완료와: History: switch week/month view, move to the previous or next period, and look back at completions and focus.
스토리: 웹 글을 읽다가 「루틴에 저장」을 누르면 루틴 탭에 바로 저장됩: Story: while reading a web article, tap Save to routines to store it in the Routines tab right away.
Turn them on in Settings → Notifications, or on the Start & wrap-up screen.
Day-start notification: alerts you at the Day start time you set.
오늘 돌아보기 알림: 정해진 시각에 오늘 진행 상황을 돌아보라고 알려 드: Look-back notification: asks you to review today's progress at the time you set.
미완료 일정 알림: 지정한 시각에 아직 끝내지 못한 일정이 있으면 개수를: Unfinished notification: if anything is still open at the time you set, it tells you how many.
루틴·복용·수분처럼 항목에 맞춰 둔 시각 알림도 함께 동작할 수 있습니다: Timed reminders you set on items such as routines, doses, or water can also fire.
iOS 설정에서 POKIT이 「알림 요약」에 들어 있으면 알림 시각이 밀: If POKIT is in Scheduled Summary in iOS Settings, the alert time can shift later.
홈 화면에 POKIT 위젯을 두면, 오늘 담은 루틴을 앱을 열지 않고도: Add a POKIT widget to the Home Screen to see today's tray without opening the app.
글씨체: 시티팝 동글, 손글씨 노트, 바이닐 세리프 등: Typeface: City-pop round, handwriting note, vinyl serif, and more
If it is your first time, set the day's start and wrap-up, then tap Start.
Browse the Routines tab or make a new routine.
나만의 루틴에서 요일을 고르고 「적용하기」를 켜거나, 오늘 탭에서 「루틴: In My routines, pick days and turn on Apply, or add them right away with Add routines on Today.
Leave a highlighter underline on what matters, and mark done as you go.
떠오른 일은 투두나 노트, 잠금화면에 남길 말은 잠금화면 메모에 적습니다: Put stray tasks in To-dos or Notes, and lock-screen words in Lock-screen memo.
When the day ends, look back by week or month in History.
For exact button placement, see Settings → User guide in the app.
기기에 로컬로 저장됩니다. 별도의 회원 가입이나 클라우드 로그인은 없습니: It is stored locally on the device. There is no sign-up or cloud login. If you delete the app or change devices, the data may not come back, so copy or share anything important first.
기본 기능은 로컬 중심으로 동작합니다. 스토리처럼 웹 글을 읽는 기능,: Core features run locally. Some parts, such as reading web stories or update notices, may need a network.
필요하지 않습니다. Apple ID로 앱을 설치하면 바로 사용할 수 있습: No. Install the app with your Apple ID and you can start right away.
There is no Start button on Today.
That is expected. Focus starts on its own when a routine is in the tray.
메모·투두·독서와 오늘 담기를 함께 쓸 수 있나요?: Can I use notes, to-dos, and reading with Today's tray?
Yes. Switch with the modes at the top of Today and the to-do icon. Modes only change the Today experience. They are not the same as moving between bottom tabs.
완료한 항목은 다시 확인할 수 있나요?: Can I see completed items again?
네. 오늘 화면의 완료 표시와 히스토리 탭에서 주간·월간으로 확인할 수: Yes. You can see the done marks on Today and look back by week or month in History.
I applied My routines, but they are not on Today.
「적용하기」가 켜져 있는지, 오늘이 적용 요일에 들어 있는지 확인해 주세: Check that Apply is on, and that today is one of the applied days. If the focus window already ended, change the focus time on Today and apply again.
iPhone 설정 → 알림 → POKIT에서 알림이 허용되어 있는지 확인: In iPhone Settings → Notifications → POKIT, make sure alerts are allowed. Also check that the alert is on in the app under Settings → Notifications. If POKIT is in Scheduled Summary, the time can shift later.
I want to change the language.
앱은 기기 언어를 따릅니다. 한국어면 한국어, 일본어면 일본어, 그 외에: The app follows the device language. Korean for Korean, Japanese for Japanese, and English otherwise. Change it in iPhone Settings → General → Language & Region, or in the POKIT app language settings.
Android에서도 쓸 수 있나요?: Can I use it on Android?
POKIT is an iOS app for now.
I want to start my data over.
설정 → 앱 데이터 초기화를 사용합니다. 저장된 일정/루틴/통계/목표 설: Use Settings → Reset app data. Saved schedules, routines, stats, goals, and scheduled alerts are all deleted and cannot be undone.
Force-quit the app, then open it again.
Check that the device has enough storage.
집중 실행 중인 항목은 삭제·일부 변경이 막힐 수 있습니다. 집중을 마친: An item in an active focus session may block delete or some edits. Finish focus, then try again.
화면이 최신 상태로 보이지 않아요: The screen does not look up to date
Switch the mode at the top of Today once, then check again.
Make sure POKIT is the latest version on the App Store.
오늘 담기에 루틴을 넣을 수 없어요: I cannot add a routine to Today's tray
집중 구간이 이미 끝났을 수 있습니다. 오늘 탭에서 시작·마무리 시각을: The focus window may already have ended. Change start and wrap-up on Today, then add it again.
You cannot set a time that has already passed.
iPhone 설정 → 알림 → POKIT → 알림 허용: iPhone Settings → Notifications → POKIT → Allow Notifications
집중/방해금지/알림 요약에 POKIT이 들어 있지 않은지 확인: Check that POKIT is not in Focus, Do Not Disturb, or Scheduled Summary
앱 안 설정 → 알림, 시작·마무리 화면의 하루 시작/돌아보기 알림이 켜: In the app, check Settings → Notifications and the day-start / look-back alerts on Start & wrap-up
The unfinished alert is scheduled only if something is still open at that time.
잠금화면 메모가 잠금화면에 안 보여요: The lock-screen memo is not on the lock screen
오늘 탭 위쪽에서 「잠금화면 메모」 모드로 들어가 내용을 저장했는지 확인: Open Lock-screen memo at the top of Today and confirm you saved the text.
Restart the iPhone, or force-quit the app and open it again.
Lock-screen display can be limited by the device or iOS version.
노트에 사진을 넣을 수 없어요: I cannot add a photo to a note
The first time you add a photo, you need to allow photo access.
iPhone 설정 → POKIT → 사진에서 접근이 허용되어 있는지 확인: In iPhone Settings → POKIT → Photos, check that access is allowed.
홈 화면에서 위젯을 길게 눌러 스택/크기를 확인한 뒤, 앱을 한 번 열어: Press and hold the widget on the Home Screen to check the stack or size, then open the app once.
Remove the widget and add it again.
If something goes wrong or you have an idea, email us below. In the app, Settings → Contact us fills in the device, OS, and app version for you.
